texts.en:
A massive energy spike has been reported in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system! The entire surface of one of the system's barren worlds has come apart, revealing some kind of planet-wide factory.

Vast fleets of strange AI-controlled vessels are emerging from beneath the surface of this Machine World in search of targets to attack.
